motive: The Aureline were the flower's first keepers. They tended it in the Heart's light for an age and named it Vitalia, the life-giver. Then they lost it, and the war that followed nearly wiped them out. What is left of them is coming home.
The Xel'Naru keep every memory of their people in living crystal. The crystal needs light. In the dark, they forget, and then they are gone.
The Vorthane's oceans are freezing from the surface down. The tide fleets have nowhere left to sail but out, and in, towards the Heart.
The Ixquor hive is starving. Its spore-worlds rot under a cooling sun, and the hive does what hives do: it spreads, and it hungers.

The Nyxari were born in the spaces between the stars, and the dark was always theirs. But the dark is growing, and it is hungry, and even the void-stalkers have learned to fear a night with nothing left in it to hunt.
The Korrath forges have burned for ten thousand years, and now the coals are cooling. A smith without fire is only a mourner. They march to the Heart for a flame that will never need feeding again.

The Seren read the future in the stars, and the stars are going out. Every night their charts have fewer lights to read. In the last of them, every reading says the same thing: the Heart, the flower, or nothing.

The Pyrr are living flame, and their sun is the only thing that has ever kept them burning. It is guttering now, and so are they. They would rather burn out in the Heart's light than fade in the dark.

heroBios.command_directive: The Solarch reads a war the way others read a map: calmly, and to the end. She lost Vitalia once, as a young officer. She has spent every year since planning how to take her back.
heroBios.ignition_protocol: The Aureline's spearhead, and their most reckless son. Aurex burns hotter than his armour can bear, and counts every scar a victory.
heroBios.empress_solenne: Last of the line that tended Vitalia in the Heart's light. Solenne has waited an age in exile, and she no longer asks.
heroBios.war_council: Keeper of the shard-archives, where every Xel'Naru who ever lived still whispers. Seris fights so that none of them are forgotten.
heroBios.coolant_protocol: A priest of stillness who can slow a burning crystal to a sleep. Vael is patient as ice, and as hard to break.
heroBios.the_shardmind: A chorus of a thousand minds grown into one crystal. It woke when the light began to fail, and it does not mean to sleep again.
heroBios.tide_regent: Regent of the last warm currents. Osshara led the tide fleets out from under the ice, and has not looked back once.
heroBios.the_admiralty: Not one admiral but a council of old captains, who speak with one voice and have never lost a fleet. They intend to keep it that way.
heroBios.leviathan_thoross: The oldest thing in the Vorthane seas, risen from the deep at last. Where Thoross swims, the tide follows.
heroBios.logistics_command: The hive's many voices, gathered into one throat. Zyth does not want, or fear, or rest. Zyth only spreads.
heroBios.chamber_protocol: The brood-mother of a hundred worlds, waking hungry. Every root she sets down becomes a new brood, and every brood an army.
heroBios.the_worldroot: A single root threaded through a dozen dying worlds. Now it is reaching for the Heart, and for every living thing between.
heroBios.nyx_hero_vesh: Queen of a court no one has ever seen. Vesh wins her wars before her enemies know they are fighting one.
heroBios.nyx_hero_kael: A Nyxari made for one purpose: to take things apart. Fleets, fortresses, alliances. Kael has never met a thing he could not undo.
heroBios.nyx_hero_nyxara: Older than the first star, and the dark was always hers. Now even she can feel it growing hungry, and she has come for the light.
heroBios.kor_hero_durga: The greatest smith of the deep forges. Durga mends what others throw away, and hammers it back into the line harder than before.
heroBios.kor_hero_brannoc: The wall the Korrath stand behind. In forty years of sieges, nothing has ever got past Brannoc. He does not mean to start now.
heroBios.kor_hero_anvil_king: The forge-lord woken from his long sleep beneath the mountain. Where the Anvil-King marches, every world is ore.
heroBios.ser_hero_ilyath: The finest reader of the stars the Seren have left. Ilyath has seen how this war ends, and is trying very hard to change it.
heroBios.ser_hero_maren: A tidecaster who turns the planets in their orbits as a sailor trims a sail. Maren asks the worlds to move, and they do.
heroBios.ser_hero_aster: Every star the Seren ever charted, gathered into a single being as the sky went dark. Aster is the last constellation, and the last hope.
heroBios.pyr_hero_ignis: Herald of the Pyrr host, who burns everything at once and lets tomorrow find its own fire. Ignis has never once held back.
heroBios.pyr_hero_ashka: Queen of the cinder-courts, who runs her people's sun hot and thrives where others scorch. Ashka was born in the fire, and does not fear it.
heroBios.pyr_hero_pyrrhus: A flare that has burned out a hundred times, and risen from its ashes each time brighter. Pyrrhus fights as if he cannot lose, because he cannot stay lost.

command_directive.join: Solarch Veyra stands with you. We lost Vitalia once. We will not lose her again.
command_directive.taunt: Vitalia was ours before your star was lit. Turn back.

ignition_protocol.join: Sol-Marshal Aurex. Point me at something, and watch it burn.
ignition_protocol.taunt: Every star can be made to blaze. Yours will be first.

empress_solenne.join: I am Solenne, last of the line that kept Vitalia. I have waited long enough. Kneel, and follow.
empress_solenne.taunt: You stand between the Empress and the flower my mothers tended. Move.

war_council.join: Archon Seris. Nothing we lose is truly lost. The shards remember.
war_council.taunt: We have remembered a thousand like you. We will remember you, too.

coolant_protocol.join: Hierarch Vael. Patience is a blade of ice. I will lend you mine.
coolant_protocol.taunt: Be still. Be cold. Be certain. You are none of these.

the_shardmind.join: We are many voices in one crystal. The Shardmind wakes for you.
the_shardmind.taunt: All that you are will be stored, and forgotten.

tide_regent.join: Tide-Regent Osshara. The tide rises with you, commander.
tide_regent.taunt: Let them break upon us, as every wave does.

the_admiralty.join: The Admiralty has the fleet. Give the word, and we sail.
the_admiralty.taunt: We have weathered worse than you. We will weather you.

leviathan_thoross.join: Thoross rises from the deep. The sea follows where I go.

logistics_command.join: Zyth hears. Zyth obeys. Zyth spreads.
logistics_command.taunt: Many voices. One will. Yours is not among them.

chamber_protocol.join: Ul'Kha wakes, and the brood with her. Every root, a promise.
chamber_protocol.taunt: Grow, my children. There is so much here to eat.

the_worldroot.join: The Worldroot stirs beneath you. Every world is soil.
the_worldroot.taunt: From one root, a thousand. From you, nothing.

nyx_hero_vesh.join: Shade-Queen Vesh. You will not see my people, commander. Neither will they, until it is too late.
nyx_hero_vesh.taunt: Look closer. No: closer. There. You see? You were never alone.

nyx_hero_kael.join: Unmaker Kael. Whatever they build, I will take apart. It is what I am for.
nyx_hero_kael.taunt: Everything you have made can be unmade. I will show you how.

nyx_hero_nyxara.join: I am Nyxara, the Unlit. I was old when the first star woke. I will see the last one through.
nyx_hero_nyxara.taunt: Your light is small, and it is going out. I can wait.

kor_hero_durga.join: Forgemother Durga. Bring me the broken, and I will make them whole, and harder than before.
kor_hero_durga.taunt: I have hammered stronger metal than you flat.

kor_hero_brannoc.join: Warden Brannoc. Stand behind me. Nothing gets past the wall.
kor_hero_brannoc.taunt: Strike, then. The wall has been waiting.

kor_hero_anvil_king.join: The Anvil-King wakes, and the forges with him. Light the fires. We march.
kor_hero_anvil_king.taunt: Every world is ore. Yours will make a fine blade.

ser_hero_ilyath.join: Star-Reader Ilyath. I have read this war to its end, commander. Shall I tell you how to win it?
ser_hero_ilyath.taunt: I have read your stars. They are very short.

ser_hero_maren.join: Tidecaster Maren. The worlds turn where I ask them. Tell me where you want them.
ser_hero_maren.taunt: Your worlds are turning against you. I made sure of it.

ser_hero_aster.join: I am Aster, the Last Constellation. Every star that ever shone shines on in me. Follow the light.
ser_hero_aster.taunt: You are not in any of my stars.

pyr_hero_ignis.join: Flame-Herald Ignis. Give me a target, and I will give it everything I have. All at once.
pyr_hero_ignis.taunt: Burn bright, or do not burn at all. You chose the second.

pyr_hero_ashka.join: Cinder-Queen Ashka. Our sun runs hot, and so do we. Stoke it. We will thrive.
pyr_hero_ashka.taunt: Feel that? That is only the warmth of my coming.

pyr_hero_pyrrhus.join: Pyrrhus, the Undying Flare. I have burned out a hundred times. I always rise again.
pyr_hero_pyrrhus.taunt: I will burn, and you will burn, and only one of us will rise.

struggleLines.command_directive: Look at your sun, burning itself hollow. Vitalia deserves better than you. I will lead us home.
struggleLines.ignition_protocol: You let the fire run away from you. A Sol-Marshal knows how to hold a blaze. Stand aside.
struggleLines.empress_solenne: My mothers kept Vitalia for a thousand years, and you cannot keep one star cool. Kneel.
struggleLines.war_council: The shards remember every leader who burned out. You are about to join them. Let me lead.
struggleLines.coolant_protocol: You run hot, and you run reckless. Ice does not follow fire. I will take the fleet.
struggleLines.the_shardmind: Your light is failing. We have voted, all of us at once. You are no longer fit to lead.
struggleLines.tide_regent: The tide does not follow a captain who is drowning. Give me the helm.
struggleLines.the_admiralty: The Admiralty has reviewed your command. Finding: unfit. We are relieving you.
struggleLines.leviathan_thoross: A leader whose star boils is no leader. The deep will choose again.
struggleLines.logistics_command: The swarm feels your fever. A sick queen is replaced. Zyth will rule.
struggleLines.chamber_protocol: Your star withers, and the brood will not follow the withered. Make way, little root.
struggleLines.the_worldroot: A root that burns feeds nothing. I will grow where you have failed.
struggleLines.nyx_hero_vesh: Your light flares and flickers. They can see you coming for miles. Let the shadows lead.
struggleLines.nyx_hero_kael: You are coming apart already. I will finish the job, and lead what is left.
struggleLines.nyx_hero_nyxara: You burn too bright, and too fast. The dark has waited long enough to lead.
struggleLines.kor_hero_durga: A blade left too long in the fire cracks. You are cracking. I will take the hammer.
struggleLines.kor_hero_brannoc: A wall does not follow a leader who cannot hold their own heat. Step down.
struggleLines.kor_hero_anvil_king: The forge does not suffer a smith who lets the metal melt. The Anvil-King leads now.
struggleLines.ser_hero_ilyath: I have read your star. It ends in fire, with you at the helm. Not with me there.
struggleLines.ser_hero_maren: Your orbit is breaking. The worlds will not turn for you any more. Let them turn for me.
struggleLines.ser_hero_aster: Every star I carry has watched you falter. You are not in any of them as a leader.
struggleLines.pyr_hero_ignis: Even a Pyrr knows when a fire is out of hand. Yours is. Give me the flame.
struggleLines.pyr_hero_ashka: We run our suns hot, but we never lose them. You are losing yours. The throne is mine.
struggleLines.pyr_hero_pyrrhus: I have died and burned again a hundred times. You cannot even burn once well. Kneel.

arrivalLines.command_directive: So many dark stars. When we kept Vitalia, this whole sky was lit. We are going home, and we are taking her back.
arrivalLines.ignition_protocol: Look at it. Cold, all of it. Good: cold things catch fire easily. Take us in towards the Heart.
arrivalLines.empress_solenne: My mothers watched the Heart from this very sky. They lost the flower. I will not. Onward.
arrivalLines.war_council: The shards are dimming already. Every star out there is a memory we cannot afford to lose. Make for the light.
arrivalLines.coolant_protocol: The dark does not frighten me. Forgetting does. Steady now, and towards the Heart.
arrivalLines.the_shardmind: We count the lights, and there are fewer than yesterday. We must reach the Heart before we forget why we came.
arrivalLines.tide_regent: Our seas are ice to the seabed. There is nowhere left to sail but in. Set a course for the Heart.
arrivalLines.the_admiralty: Admiralty flagship on station. Ice behind us, dead stars ahead. The fleet sails for the Heart.
arrivalLines.leviathan_thoross: I left a frozen ocean for this? Then this had better be worth the cold. Onward, to the Heart.
arrivalLines.logistics_command: Zyth smells warm worlds, there, and there. Zyth's brood is hungry. Zyth goes towards the Heart.
arrivalLines.chamber_protocol: Our spore-worlds are rotting, children. But look: soil, all the way to the Heart. Spread.
arrivalLines.the_worldroot: The old soil is dead. Here, new soil. Every world between us and the Heart, a place to take root.
arrivalLines.nyx_hero_vesh: The dark was always ours. Now it eats the stars, and soon it will eat us. Quietly, then. Towards the Heart.
arrivalLines.nyx_hero_kael: So many dead lights, and every race clawing for the last ones. Let them build. I will take it all apart on the way to the Heart.
arrivalLines.nyx_hero_nyxara: I have watched these stars wake, one by one. Now I watch them go out. I would rather not watch the last.
arrivalLines.kor_hero_durga: The forges back home are ash and embers. Out there is a fire that never needs feeding. We go and get it.
arrivalLines.kor_hero_brannoc: Cold worlds, cold road, and enemies on every lane of it. Stay behind me. We reach the Heart together.
arrivalLines.kor_hero_anvil_king: Ten thousand years our forges burned. They will burn ten thousand more, once we have the Heart. March.
arrivalLines.ser_hero_ilyath: Fewer stars to read every night, and every reading ends the same: the Heart, the flower, or nothing. So: the Heart.
arrivalLines.ser_hero_maren: The orbits are slowing. Worlds that once sang now barely turn. Set our course. The Heart is waiting.
arrivalLines.ser_hero_aster: I carry every star that ever shone, and still the sky goes dark. Follow me, and we will light it again.
arrivalLines.pyr_hero_ignis: Our sun is guttering, and we gutter with it. If we burn out, we burn out in the Heart's light. Full burn!
arrivalLines.pyr_hero_ashka: It is so cold out here. Feel that? Nothing. Then we bring the heat ourselves, all the way to the Heart.
arrivalLines.pyr_hero_pyrrhus: I have died and risen a hundred times. This dark will not be the end of me. To the Heart.

quartermasterLines: Prices are up. Everything is up, except the light.
The supply chain's fine. It's the supply that's gone.
Mined that from a moon that isn't there any more. Don't ask which.
Buy it now. The world that made it may not be there next turn.
We were told there would always be more. There was always more, right up until there wasn't.
Everyone wants growth. Nobody asks what it grows out of.
Half my stock came from stars we burned too hot, too fast. Cheap at the time.
Quarterly yields were excellent, right up until the last quarter.
recyclerLines: Everything you throw away goes somewhere. Out here, it comes back round and orbits you.
My mother had a banner: reduce, reuse, recycle. We kept the banner. We didn't keep the habit.
Every card is made of something that was once a world. Mind how you waste it.
Single-use starships. Who thought that was a good idea? Everybody, that's who.
They said the dimming was a natural cycle. Some of it was. Most of it was us.
Every degree we added to the suns, we said we would fix later. It is later.
The seas on the tide worlds rose a hand a year. They built higher docks, and never asked why.
Nothing is ever really thrown away. It's only put where you can't see it, for a while.
Bring me what you will not use. Half of something is better than all of nothing.

lessons.name: the sun

intro.text: Every side has a sun. Heat a rival’s sun to its limit and it goes supernova: the battle is yours.
Theirs stands at 17 of 20.
Your lancer can attack once a day. Tap it, then tap their sun.

lessons.done: One blow, and a star goes out. Every battle ends this way.
lessons.hint: Attack their sun with your lancer: tap it, then tap their sun.

lessons.name: energy

intro.text: Cards wait in your hand. Each costs energy, the number on its gem.
This is your energy for the day. It grows as the days pass.
Coronal Lance heats a sun by 3 as it is played. Play it at their sun.

lessons.done: Cards spend energy; a day’s energy is a day’s choices.
lessons.hint: Play Coronal Lance, aimed at their sun.

lessons.name: guard

intro.text: A Guard must be attacked first. While it stands, your lancer can’t reach their sun.
But heat from a card you play goes where you aim it.

lessons.done: Guards stop attacks, not aimed heat. Remember which is which.
lessons.hint: Your lancer can only hit the Guard. Aim the Lance’s heat at their sun instead.

lessons.name: breaking through

intro.text: An attack on a card goes through its defence first: its slot’s and its own (Sturdy). What gets past breaks its stability.
At no stability left, it is gone. Middle slots defend best; the edges least.
Break the Guard with your strongest attacker, then strike the sun.

lessons.done: Order matters: clear the way, then strike.
lessons.hint: The lancer can’t break that Guard. Break it with the spear, then strike the sun with the lancer.

lessons.name: shields

intro.text: Not every battle is won in a day. Their two attackers will hit your sun for 8 tomorrow: 21. Too hot.
Shields take heat before your sun does. They fade at your next dawn.
Raise them, then end your day.

lessons.done: You lived. Shields buy you a day; use it.
lessons.hint: Raise your shields before you end your day.

lessons.name: cooling

intro.text: The same threat, and your sun a little hotter.
Cooling takes heat off your sun for good. Play the vault, then end your day.

lessons.done: Shields last a day; cooling lasts.
lessons.hint: Cool your sun with the vault before you end your day.

lessons.name: removal

intro.text: Their spear hits for 6 tomorrow. Your sun can’t take it.
Ion Cannon destroys a card with 2 defence or less, at the price of a little heat on your own sun.
A card at the edge has little defence. Aim at the spear.

lessons.done: The best defence is sometimes taking theirs away.
lessons.hint: Destroy their spear before it strikes.

lessons.name: traps

intro.text: A trap is set face down in this slot. It springs by itself on your rival’s day.
Ink Cloud cancels an attack on your sun. Set it, then end your day.

lessons.done: Your rival never saw it coming. Neither will the next.
lessons.hint: Set Ink Cloud face down before you end your day.

lessons.name: forge

intro.text: The Aureline fight as one. A card with Forge lends its neighbours’ attacks more heat.
Your two attackers make 6. You need 7. Where you place a card matters.

lessons.done: Side by side, they burn brighter.
lessons.hint: Place the sentinel beside an attacker first, then attack with both.

lessons.name: overheat

intro.text: At half its limit or hotter, your sun is overheated. The Xel’Naru hit harder when it is.
Overcharge gives energy, and heats your own sun. Shard Storm hits harder while you’re overheated. Order matters.

lessons.hint: Overcharge first: Shard Storm hits harder once your sun is overheated.

lessons.name: growth

intro.text: A Hero leads from its own slot. Once a day it may use one of its abilities.
Growth adds to a card’s attack, for good. Grow your warrior, then attack.

lessons.hint: Grow the warrior with your Hero’s ability first, then attack.

lessons.name: heroes

intro.text: A Hero acts once a day: an attack, or one of its abilities. Tap it to see them.
Three to go. Its attack is 2. Choose well.

lessons.done: A Hero leads every deck. Guard yours.
lessons.hint: Strafe deals 3; the Hero’s attack only 2.

lessons.name: dusk

intro.text: Some cards act at dawn, as your day begins; some at dusk, as it ends.
Vigil acts at dusk only if the card held back that day. Their Guard is too strong to break.
Sometimes the strongest move is to wait.

lessons.done: Patience is a weapon too. You have learnt the core.
lessons.hint: Don’t attack. Hold back, and end your day: the vigil fires at dusk.

lessons.name: darkspeed

intro.text: Cards come into play dimmed: they act from the next day. Not the Nyxari’s.
Darkspeed: play it, and attack the same day.

lessons.hint: Play the stalker, then attack with it at once.

lessons.name: consume

intro.text: Consume: to play it, give up one of your own cards in play.
Your thrall burns as it leaves. Two fires for the price of one.

lessons.done: What is given is never wasted.
lessons.hint: Play the rite, and give up your thrall to it.

lessons.name: erode

intro.text: No attack of yours gets through that wall’s defence.
Erode takes stability whatever the defence. Then the way is open.

lessons.hint: Erode the wall first, then attack.

lessons.name: walls as weapons

intro.text: The Korrath stack defence on everything they build.
Molten Pour heats more for the defence on your cards. Strike, and pour.

lessons.hint: Use every point of heat: attack, and pour.

lessons.name: spend all

intro.text: Spend all: a card that takes every bit of energy you have left, and grows with it.
Four energy. Make it count.

lessons.hint: Spend all four energy on the charge at once.

lessons.name: the long game

intro.text: Some battles take more than a day. You have two to bring their sun down from 1.
What you play today fights tomorrow too. Every point of heat counts.

lessons.done: You see further now. You have learnt all I can teach.
lessons.hint: Play the Forge before you attack, so it lends its heat on both days.
